notes: This contract traces the bounded embedded IEEE 1516.1-2025 order-type lookup slice. It covers the mandatory Receive and TimeStamp legal names and the Get Order Type/Get Order Name return mappings. Order-change services, per-instance preferred-order state, alternate time/TSO modes, save/restore, transport, protected review, catalog evidence, JUnit evidence, and conformance remain outside this contract.
